snippet.title: The Player Who Can't Level Up - Game Trailer(2026)
snippet.description:
- Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2985520/The_Player_Who_Cant_Level_Up/
- Stove Store Page: https://store.onstove.com/games/102023
- PS5 Store Page: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015926/

Based on the hit Webtoon and web novel loved by millions worldwide, The Player Who Can’t Level Up reimagines its universe as a fast-paced action roguelite built for PC and consoles.

The Player Who Can’t Level Up is not just an adaptation, but an expansion of the original IP, offering a new way to experience its world through action, choice, and relentless challenge.

Demo will be released in 2026 1H so don't forget to wishlist!
